summary: Full-stack testing of Chala Le Gouter Antillais bilingual restaurant website. All backend APIs pass. Frontend loads correctly with French/English language switching, all navigation links work, contact form submits successfully.

ui_bugs.issue: Sections below hero (map, form, event types) are not visible in viewport on initial load - likely scroll-reveal animation not triggered without user scroll. Form still works correctly when scrolled to.

issues: Design looks professional and consistent. Color palette (deep orange, gold, cream, black) applied correctly. Good contrast on hero text.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/contact endpoint at line 73-74 has a fragile response construction that may fail if MongoDB documents lack expected fields - consider using safer dict access
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') - should use lifespan context manager for FastAPI best practices

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all pages load, nav works, lang switcher works, contact form submits, mobile call button visible, Uber Eats link present

seed_data_creation: Test contact messages submitted via form and API tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: health, root, contact POST/GET all pass. Frontend: All 6 nav routes work (/,/menu,/about,/catering,/reviews,/contact). FR/EN language switch works. Hero CTAs visible (Commander en Ligne, Voir le Menu, Appeler). Menu page has category tabs (Tous les Plats, Griot, Jerk Chicken, Riz & Haricots, Bananes Plantains, Patties, Desserts). Reviews page shows 4.9 rating with testimonials. Contact form uses data-testid: contact-name-input, contact-email-input, contact-subject-input, contact-message-input, contact-submit-btn. Mobile floating call button confirmed via data-testid=mobile-call-btn. Footer shows address, hours, quick links.
